```python
import operator

def sum_squares(lst):
    squared = [(i, n**2) for i, n in enumerate(lst) if i % 3 == 0]
    cubed = [(i, n**3) for i, n in enumerate(lst) if (i % 4 == 0) and (i % 3 != 0)]
    updated_lst = [n for i, n in lst if (i % 3 != 0) and (i % 4 != 0)]
    transformed_lst = squared + cubed
    result = sum(transformed_lst) + sum(updated_lst)
    return result
```
